## Controller profiles (all songs)

Each profile re-runs assignment + repair. Cell = `clean songs / total` (no remaining violations and within bell capacity), then Σ violations, Σ dropped harmony notes, songs over bell capacity.

- `handbell`: Traditional two-in-hand ringing with table pickups (real bells) (maxBells 6, maxSimultaneous 2, minRepeat 0.18s, minSwitch 0s, swap 0.4s)
- `phone-4zone`: One phone covering up to 4 bells (on-screen zones), one strike at a time (maxBells 4, maxSimultaneous 1, minRepeat 0.2s, minSwitch 0.2s, swap n/a)
- `phone-pair`: Two phones per ringer (one bell per hand), no table bells (maxBells 2, maxSimultaneous 2, minRepeat 0.18s, minSwitch 0s, swap n/a)
- `phone-2zone`: One phone covering 2 bells (bell chosen by touch zone/tilt), one strike at a time (maxBells 2, maxSimultaneous 1, minRepeat 0.2s, minSwitch 0.2s, swap n/a)
- `phone-1`: One phone = one bell (maxBells 1, maxSimultaneous 1, minRepeat 0.2s, minSwitch Infinitys, swap n/a)
